lines.t: I see them passing by, looking the other way
Ignoring your light, choosing the dark each day
My soul aches deeply, it's hard to understand
How they turned from the love you freely planned
You gave it all, every breathe, every drop
And though the world had turned away
Your love for them hasn't stopped
I lift my hands, I kneel and pray
Hoping hearts will find the way
It breaks my heart, brings tears to my eyes
The way that they despise you
You have done so much for them
You have always loved them
It saddens me to see your children
Running away from their true home
They think it's better off alone
Alone
Through storms and trials I've gone through
You've been so near
Yet so many in the world live in doubt
Out in fear
Your mercy flows
Your light so true
Why can't they see
What I see in you
Your treasure treats you
As if you're gone
They forget the love
You've carried all along
The one who gave everything
To save you
They ignore the path you've paved
It breaks my heart, brings tears to my eyes
The way that they despise you, you have done so much for them
You have always loved them, it saddens me to see your children
Running away from their true home, they think it's better off alone
It breaks my heart
Brings tears to my eyes
The way that they despise you
You gave your life the greatest gift
Though they turned away, you gave it all for them
I will always follow you
And it saddens me
that this world
doesn't
too
